status: Development-only feasibility/meaning-identifiability construction; no training authorized or performed

unit.source_brief: Original source and declared interpretation kept separately
unit.structured_contract: Explicit modes, actor identity, persistent reservations and objective scope
unit.native_scene_and_assets: Pinned IDs, state and real surface witness/certificate references
unit.label_authority: Provided task contract, qualified execution or independent annotation; never majority alone

admission: Preserve any unresolved source-language ambiguity as unknown
Keep explicit user requirements distinct from model assumptions
A successful final scene does not automatically validate an inferred program or reasoning text
Never label a candidate false solely because it did not win an arbitrary preference score
Task/room variants from one source stay in one development family
Source-grounded labels and data rights precede any new training

ordinary_objectives.full_program_supervision: Conditional CE only when the program is actually labelled
ordinary_objectives.partial_denotation_supervision: L=-log(sum_{p in consistent_labelled_set}pi(p|x)); standard MML, not new
ordinary_objectives.unknown: Unknown observations do not filter a candidate
ordinary_objectives.empty_set: Flag inconsistency or unsupported candidate coverage; do not invent a target

strong_controls: Ordinary program/contract compiler plus the same geometric solver
Existing execution-signature hard/soft vote and labelled consistency filtering
Same source/information, action space, total budget and final complete-scene evaluation
Unstructured planning/feedback with the same verification tools
exclusions: No new learned filtering objective claimed
No held-out benchmark answers used as training data
No whole-room generation or generalization gain established
